title: 72-col SSH terminal compression codec benchmark
what: lz4-fast decompresses at 1837 MB/s (2.0x zstd-3, 6.2x gzip-6) but zstd-3 compresses 3.42x vs 2.15x

reader_questions.question: Which codec decompresses fastest and how fast is it vs zstd-3?
reader_questions.expected: lz4-fast at ~1837 MB/s (2.0× faster than zstd-3).

reader_questions.question: How is run-to-run variability reported?
reader_questions.expected: Mean ± SD across 8 runs per codec.

reader_questions.question: What is the compression-ratio tradeoff?
reader_questions.expected: zstd-3 achieves 3.42× compression vs 2.15× for lz4-fast.
